intent: A technical four-view sheet for 3D reconstruction from the reference.
subject: Same subject in all cells. Keep identity, proportions, shape, clothes, accessories, colors and materials. Infer unseen surfaces conservatively.
composition: Strict equal 2x2 grid: top-left front; top-right back; bottom-left subject left; bottom-right subject right. Orthographic full-body views, same upright pose, scale and vertical center. Each complete silhouette fills its cell with a small safety margin.
text: No text, labels, logos or watermarks.
style: Reference appearance, neutral solid background, soft even studio light, sharp edges.
constraints: Four subjects total, one per cell. No perspective, three-quarter angles, changed poses, cropped parts, overlap, separators, gutters, scenery or large blank margins. Exact requested canvas size. Cells will be cut at geometric midpoints.
